scientific_integrity: Signed-support vertices and the polar realization are existing results credited to the primary source. The contribution assessed here is the joint width/rank fluctuation theorem. Standard Gaussian asymptotics are inputs. No independent validation or definitive uniqueness certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the standard ambient Euclidean cube–crosspolytope polar realization, not every affine realization of a signohedron.
The Gaussian law is asymptotic; no finite-dimensional normal identity or quantitative convergence rate is asserted.
An equivalent statement under a different Gaussian empirical-threshold or norm-duality formulation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Joint Gaussian width–support-rank fluctuations of canonical signohedra
